findings.issue: All HIGH severity security vulnerabilities from initial review have been resolved: Authentication fail-closed implemented, rate limiting function signature unified, server-generated filenames enforced, evidence files protected via .htaccess.
findings.recommendation: Continue with remaining technical improvements focused on mobile sync reliability.

findings.issue: RESOLVED - Design now specifies exact jitter algorithm: ±25% of base exponential delay to prevent thundering herd scenarios.
findings.recommendation: Implementation ready. Monitor jitter effectiveness under high concurrency during testing.

findings.issue: RESOLVED - Design upgrades to cryptographically secure token generation using secure random bytes + timestamp + hash, eliminating collision vulnerability.
findings.recommendation: Implementation ready. Test token generation performance under load to ensure acceptable overhead.

findings.issue: Design provides comprehensive retrofit of existing sync service with centralized HTTP client, conservative retry limits (maxRetries ≤ 1), and concurrency controls appropriate for rural connections.
findings.recommendation: Implementation ready. Use feature flags for gradual rollout and establish performance baselines before deployment.

findings.issue: Design adds targeted indexes for rate limiting and idempotency queries without over-engineering. Resource monitoring enhancements provide operational visibility.
findings.recommendation: Implementation ready. Schedule index creation during off-peak hours to minimize impact.

findings.issue: Design correctly identifies deployment risks (performance impact, breaking changes) and provides appropriate mitigation strategies (feature flags, gradual rollout, monitoring first approach).
findings.recommendation: Follow phased implementation plan strictly. Deploy monitoring and alerting infrastructure before behavior changes. Ensure team training on new retry policies.
